'''Banshee''' is an enemy in [[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|''Ninja Gaiden (NES)'']]. 

=='''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]]'''== 
[[File:BansheeL.gif|80px]]

First appearing in [[Death Valley|Act 2-2]], Banshees are potentially one of the most dangerous enemies in the game. As with all lobbers, they slowly lumber back and forth along their post, and attack randomly by throwing a big dagger in a random arc. Due to these random attacks, the difficulty of dealing against them fluctuates. Both their contact and dagger attacks do 1 damage, and they are best defeated using sub-weapons to work around the dagger.

==Trivia==
* In the original NES game, the enemy's design had green skin and was cast in a pink cloak, giving it a zombie-esque look which was kept in the SNES trilogy.
** However, in the PC Engine version, the design was changed to look more like a regular human in a maroon cloak, and was equipped with sickles instead.
